snippet.title: Steal The Pig - First Trailer
snippet.description: STEAL THE PIG — a cooperative platformer where you play as two thieves trying to steal a pig. Be careful, because this pig isn’t one who enjoys traveling! Try not to wake it up or let it escape! Get ready for tons of fun, unexpected situations, and a real test of teamwork.  The game is inspired by projects like Split Fiction, It Takes Two, and Chained Together, but with a unique atmosphere and its own approach to co-op.
